overclaims: The comparison uses Nasdaq closing prices from October 6 to November 19, 2026, and from March 10, 2000, to October 9, 2002 [e1].
checks.note: The rationale opens with 'The comparison uses…' without naming the source. Readers could take it as Marcus's or the tweet's comparison. The evidence only shows Trading N Investment's own method, not what the speaker relied on. The e1 public excerpt 'to the November 19 close.' is a fragment that leaves out the October 6, 2026 start and the 2000–2002 dates the rationale cites, so the citation doesn't show the cited fact. Outcome, axis and horizon match the reviews.

The rationale is supported. e5 shows the 14.48% drop at the November 20 Tokyo close, rounding to 14.5%. e6 shows $64.6B in cumulative OpenAI investment as of October 1, 2026. Outcome unresolved matches the reviews. However, the e6 public excerpt '$64.6' cuts off 'billion', so the cited figure has no units and is misleading on its own. Use the full phrase, e.g. 'cumulative investments by the Company in OpenAI amounted to $64.6 billion.'
